integrity_review.notes: Answers whether the underlying authored/researched artifact has passed integrity review. Automated generation or verification never self-promotes candidate to approved.

asset_trust.notes: Existing product trust vocabulary. A lesson session inherits the minimum trust of the assets it actually renders.

lesson_release.notes: Audience/readiness gate for a resolved lesson part + directional language pair + completeness tier. This is not a replacement for integrity review or asset trust.

release_requirements.integrity_rule: Candidate integrity is allowed. The lesson may exist internally with visible gaps and is not implied to be public-beta ready.
release_requirements.notes: Machine-created includes deterministic or machine-authored scaffolding whose required components may still be partial or missing.

release_requirements.integrity_rule: Automated verification may leave integrity review as candidate. It must not fabricate approval.
release_requirements.notes: This is the minimum audience gate for public beta. Required components for the resolved Core/Full tier must pass the machine-verification contract.

release_requirements.integrity_rule: All linguistically load-bearing rendered assets must meet the repository's public-release review policy; candidate-only assets cannot silently satisfy this gate.
release_requirements.notes: General-public readiness is stricter than public beta and remains directional/component-aware.

release_requirements.integrity_rule: Education release requires approved/qualified human review for the school-facing material and any additional classroom policy checks.
release_requirements.notes: Education is the school/classroom gate, not an automatic synonym for technically correct or generally public.
